title: Modern Scottsdale Luxury w/ Pool & Guest Retreat
description:
Thoughtfully designed Scottsdale luxury home with private pool, side-yard putting green, and a dedicated upstairs guest retreat ideal for group stays. Open indoor-outdoor living, a chef’s kitchen with oversized island, and 5.5 bathrooms make gathering easy and comfortable. Multiple seating areas, hotel-style bedrooms, and a layout built for real travel. Minutes to Old Town Scottsdale, golf courses, dining, shopping, hiking trails, spring training venues, and top-rated restaurants and nightlife.

 The space 
Designed for how groups actually travel, this Scottsdale luxury home combines open gathering spaces with natural separation for comfort and flexibility. The main level features a bright chef’s kitchen, oversized island seating, fast Wi-Fi workspace, and seamless indoor-outdoor living opening directly to the private pool and outdoor dining areas.

Six bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms help large groups stay comfortably. The entire upstairs functions as a dedicated guest retreat with kitchenette and exterior stair access. While connected by an open interior staircase (no closing door), it provides excellent separation for multi-generation families, golf groups, or guests keeping different schedules.

Outdoor living includes a private pool, built-in BBQ, shaded lounge seating, and a side-yard putting green for relaxed practice between pool time and dinner. Pool heating is optional and may be added for an additional nightly fee with advance notice. The home is designed to feel comfortable, social, and easy to enjoy.

 Guest access 
Guests have full private access to the home, garage, and backyard during their stay. One owner supply closet remains locked. Self check-in with smart lock allows convenient arrival during approved check-in hours.

 Other things to note 
• Pool heating is optional and not included in nightly rates. Heating may be added for $90/night with 48-hour advance notice (3-night minimum).

• Quiet hours are 10pm–6am per City of Scottsdale regulations. This professionally hosted home is designed for relaxed gatherings and is not suitable for parties or events. This is a professionally managed, owner-operated home in a residential neighborhood, and we appreciate guests who respect the home and surrounding community.

• No parties, events, weddings, or commercial photo/video shoots are permitted unless previously approved by the host. All visitors must be included on the reservation and listed by name on the rental agreement. Unregistered guests are not permitted on the property without prior approval.

• After booking, the primary guest is required to complete a rental agreement and provide government-issued photo identification to verify name, address, and phone number. These items must be submitted within 48 hours of booking. Reservations that remain incomplete after this period may be subject to cancellation by the host without penalty.

• The primary booking guest must be 25 years of age or older and must be present for the duration of the stay.

• Same-day reservations must be confirmed before 10:00 AM MST. Local bookings may require additional approval.

• For the safety of the property and neighborhood, reservations may be declined or cancelled if publicly available information or booking behavior indicates a history of violent, property-related, or party-related offenses that could reasonably pose a risk to the home or community.

• Stays longer than one week include periodic cleanings billed separately.

• Up to two dogs allowed with prior approval. Pets may not be left unattended in the home.

• Level 2 EV charger available in garage (Tesla compatible).
